describes: packages/plugin/annotation: group, ungroup, their twins, and the grouped Replace Text create with rollback.

cases.name: a-pair-groups
cases.covers: Two committed members on one page are enough: canGroup says so and group writes the one subordinate.

cases.name: group-and-ungroup
cases.covers: canGroup needs 2+ committed members on one page, each passing the update check, and not already one complete group. group makes the bottom-most member the primary and writes /IRT + /RT /Group onto the rest (a relationship-only patch, source preserved); ungroup clears it on every subordinate of the touched groups.

cases.name: group-refused-per-record
cases.covers: Without update authority neither verb is offered; the engine’s refusal of a group write rejects group().

cases.name: replace-text-creates-a-group
cases.covers: createReplaceText commits the Caret first, then the StrikeOut with /IRT to the created Caret and /RT /Group, reconciling each temp id and syncing each DTO as vector; both stay selected.

cases.name: replace-text-rolls-back
cases.covers: A refused StrikeOut create deletes the committed Caret (compensation in reverse) and removes both parts; a Caret whose rollback delete also fails stays visible. A refused primary removes both temp parts. A group on a page without a crop never reaches the engine.
